en.title: New Uncharted Game Rumored After Intergalactic: Heretic Prophet
en.summary: Whispers from the gaming world suggest Naughty Dog is gearing up for a return to the Uncharted franchise. This potential new installment would follow their upcoming original IP, Intergalactic: Heretic Prophet.
en.body:
The jungle is alive with rumors, and this time, the whispers point towards a return to the globe-trotting adventures of **Nathan Drake**. Sources close to industry insider MP1st suggest that **Naughty Dog**, the acclaimed studio behind *The Last of Us* and the original *Uncharted* series, is actively developing a brand-new entry in the beloved franchise. This isn't expected to be a remake, but rather an entirely new chapter, marking the first Uncharted title since 2017's standalone expansion, **Uncharted: The Lost Legacy**, and the first mainline installment since 2016's **Uncharted 4: A Thief's End**.

Details are understandably scarce, but the report indicates that this new **Uncharted** game will be **Naughty Dog**'s next major project *after* the release of their new intellectual property, **Intergalactic: Heretic Prophet**. While an official release date for *Intergalactic* hasn't been confirmed, some industry projections place its launch in late 2026. This timeline suggests that a new **Uncharted** adventure might not see the light of day until 2027 or later. Shaun Escayg, a key figure at **Naughty Dog** who worked on previous **Uncharted** titles, has been teasing a new project through cryptic social media posts, further fueling speculation. One such post featured an old cannon overlooking a seaside city, captioned simply with "Research…", a tantalizing clue for longtime fans.

## The Return of Drake?

The prospect of a new **Uncharted** game has sent waves of excitement through the community. For many, the series represents a pinnacle of cinematic action-adventure gaming, blending thrilling set pieces with compelling characters and a healthy dose of humor. The possibility that **Nathan Drake** himself will feature in some capacity, even if not as the primary playable character, is a major talking point. Fans are eager to see how **Naughty Dog** would evolve the franchise, especially after their more mature and narrative-heavy work on *The Last of Us*. The studio's track record speaks for itself, and any new **Uncharted** title would undoubtedly carry the hallmarks of their signature polish and storytelling prowess. The community is abuzz with theories about the potential plot, setting, and mechanics, eagerly awaiting any official word.

## What's Next for Naughty Dog

While **Naughty Dog** remains tight-lipped, focusing its current efforts on **Intergalactic: Heretic Prophet**, this rumored **Uncharted** project, potentially followed by **The Last of Us Part 3**, paints an exciting picture for the studio's future. Fans should keep a close eye on official announcements from **Naughty Dog** regarding their upcoming slate, particularly after the release of their new IP. The wait for concrete details continues, but the possibility of a new treasure hunt is certainly on the horizon.

content_raw: Following recent reports about a secret project in the works at Naughty Dog seemingly not being related to The Last of Us , a new one indicates that it might be a brand-new entry in the Uncharted franchise. According to Mp1st , the new game will seemingly once more feature series protagonist Nathan Drake in some way. However, whether he will be playable or not remains unknown. The report also notes that it is not going to be a remake. Despite Naughty Dog seemingly having at least discussed the idea of a remake of Uncharted: Drake’s Fortune , the project is instead an entirely new game, making it the first one in the franchise since 2017’s Uncharted: The Lost Legacy , and the first mainline one since 2016’s Uncharted 4: A Thief’s End . The project is being headed up by Shaun Escayg, who fans of Naughty Dog will recall has been teasing a new project through a cryptic social media post. Escayg is no stranger to the Uncharted franchise, having previously worked on the last two entries. As for when this game might come out, the report notes that Naughty Dog will start working on it after the release of Intergalactic . The Uncharted title will then apparently be followed up with The Last of Us Part 3 . It is worth keeping in mind that Naughty Dog itself is yet to make any announcements regarding the Uncharted franchise. The company has chosen to stay silent on the matter, instead focusing its attention on the ongoing development of Intergalactic . Escayg teased this secret project with an Instagram post earlier this year. The post featured a picture of an old cannon on a wall, with a seaside city being visible in the distance. While far from an official announcement, Escayg simply wrote “Research…” in the post’s caption. Earlier this week, noted industry leaker NateTheHate said that the studio is seemingly working on something unrelated to The Last of Us , but it was “nothing I’m prepared to share at present”, which indicates that the project is likely still quite early in development, and there are few details that have been nailed down even internally. As for what a new Uncharted game might entail, we saw Naughty Dog experimenting with the formula with The Lost Legacy, which featured Chloe Frazer and Nadine Ross as its protagonists rather than focusing on Nathan Drake. While the story largely stuck to the franchise’s roots with plenty of action and puzzle-solving along the way, Naughty Dog experimented quite a bit with its gameplay, with a middle chapter featuring a large open zone that players could freely explore and take on objectives in any order. As for Drake, the character’s story arc has been largely considered finished with the events of Uncharted 4: A Thief’s End by fans of the franchise, with many players praising how the story ended things with Drake reconciling with his brother and learning to become more responsible for his new family.
